card.name: Linking words in boxed warning headings
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words such as 'and', 'can', 'has', 'with' in all-caps warning headings or section headers. Also some word starts inside drug and ingredient names.

modes.label: Linking word in warning headline
modes.description: 'and', 'can' or 'has' joining the risks listed in a boxed warning or heading.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIAC TOXICITY, SECONDARY MALIGNANCIES, EXTRAVASATION AND TISSUE NECROSIS,<< and>> SEVERE MYELOSUPPRESSION

modes.label: Start of a name
modes.description: The opening piece of a split drug or ingredient name or heading word.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in the bold warning headlines at the top of drug labels.
